content.text:
Moved the Vercel flow off the working branch and onto metadata-branch writes.

`entire configure` now records `vercel: true` in [.entire/settings.json](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go) after detection/confirmation instead of writing `vercel.json` into the current branch. If an existing `vercel.json` already disables Entire branches, it skips the prompt and records the setting directly. The shared branch pattern is now `entire/**` via [vercelconfig.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/vercelconfig/vercelconfig.go).

On the metadata side, both checkpoint writes in [committed.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go) and orphan metadata-branch creation in [common.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/common.go) now generate or merge a root-level `vercel.json` on `entire/checkpoints/v1`, preserving existing Vercel config and forcing `git.deploymentEnabled["entire/**"] = false`.

Verified with:
`env GOCACHE=/tmp/entire-cli-gocache go test ./cmd/entire/cli/settings ./cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint`
`env GOCACHE=/tmp/entire-cli-gocache go test ./cmd/entire/cli -run 'TestMaybePromptVercelDeploymentDisable'`
`env GOCACHE=/tmp/entire-cli-gocache go test ./cmd/entire/cli/strategy -run 'TestEnsureMetadataBranch'`

I did not run the full repo test suite; one broader strategy package run hits an unrelated sandbox restriction around binding a local `httptest` TLS port.
In entire configure, instead of only checking for Vercel when an agent was added, do the check on every run unless the setting for vercel already exists and is true.
I’m adjusting `entire configure` so Vercel detection runs on every configure pass, not just when hooks were added, while still skipping once `.entire/settings.json` already has `vercel: true`.
I’m making this minimal: remove the “only if agents were added” guards and rely on `maybePromptVercelDeploymentDisable`’s own early exit when `.entire/settings.json` already has `vercel: true`.
